name: Workout summary
summary: A finished run: who ran it, a route drawn on a token map, distance, time, pace and heart rate, time in each heart-rate zone, splits per kilometre with the fastest marked, and save and share.
use: after a run, ride or walk ends, for the summary screen people screenshot and share
a11y: The map is one image with a plain description; stats are a description list, splits a table with column headers, and Save route is a toggle button with aria-pressed.
